paragraphs.text: The Horn Monument refers to the twin horn-shaped architectural pillars that flank certain key artifacts and landmarks on Amonkhet , most notably the Throne of the God-Pharaoh , erected by Bolas in his visage, enchanted to appear stationary from every angle. They were built to frame the Second Sun on the horizon at the moment of his choosing . These horns became an iconic symbol of the plane , visible in the skyline and referenced in the storyline, intending to signify his dominance, serving as both decoration and symbolic pillars of his authority.
Following the Final Hours and the War of the Spark , the Horn Monument was left damaged and ruined.
